summary: Phase 4 Slice C (documents dual-write Mongo + Supabase Postgres + Storage) verified GREEN end-to-end. Backend pytest: 28/28 PASS (test_iteration12_phase4c_documents_dualwrite.py). Direct probes of Postgres (asyncpg via SUPABASE_DIRECT_URL) and Supabase Storage (service-role client) confirm: (1) POST /api/documents with file_base64 returns the Document shape and the row appears in Mongo + Postgres (storage_path=documents/<id>.pdf) and the binary lands in Storage; (2) POST /api/documents with no blob still dual-writes metadata, leaves storage_path NULL in Postgres, and creates NO blob in Storage; (3) GET /api/documents/{id}/url returns {url, expires_in:3600, storage_path} for blob docs and the URL fetches a real application/pdf with the %PDF- magic header WITHOUT auth; (4) the same endpoint either 404s for meta-only docs or returns a URL whose Storage GET 400/404s (no real PDF served — verified); (5) unknown id -> 404; (6) DELETE /api/documents/{id} cascades to Mongo (subsequent GET 404), Postgres (row count 0), and Storage (blob removed); (7) POST /api/documents/{src_id}/push with two caregiver targets creates 2 clones each with its OWN uuid, each appears in Mongo + Postgres with its OWN storage_path, each has its OWN blob in Storage, and signed URLs work per-clone; (8) POST /api/documents/{id}/sign overlays the drawn signature on the last PDF page, returns a new document under the signer that is present in BOTH DBs and Storage, signed URL fetches the signed PDF; (9) POST /api/documents/{id}/submit-form on a fillable template (the suite picks the first caregiver_onboarding doc whose form-schema endpoint returns has_form=true — currently '01 - Employment Application') generates a COMPLETED-titled filled PDF that lands in BOTH DBs + Storage with a working signed URL. Phase 4 Slice A regression: /auth/me, /caregivers, /clients, /clients/{id}, /stats all pass under both legacy HS256 (Admin@123) and Supabase ES256 (AdminPassword123!) JWTs. Phase 4 Slice B regression: client create dual-writes (Postgres row visible immediately), assignment POST is idempotent (same caregiver_id+client_id returns same id, PG row-count stays 1), delete client cascades the assignment away (ON DELETE CASCADE). Non-converted reads regression: GET /api/documents returns 50 baseline docs from Mongo; GET /api/documents/{id} still returns file_base64. Other routes /api/shifts /api/onboarding /api/training all 200. Final parity: PG documents=50, Mongo documents=50, delta=0 after all churn. Frontend regression (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844): legacy mode + Admin@123 and Supabase mode + AdminPassword123! BOTH land on the Dashboard (1 Client / 12 Caregivers / 50 Documents / 0 Trainings); Documents tab loads 'Document Vault — 50 items', 27 view-doc-<uuid> tiles render (rest are template rows without file_base64), tapping a tile opens the form modal for '01 - Employment Application'. The default login mode is 'Auth: Supabase'; users must tap the toggle to use legacy creds — pre-existing UX, not a regression. No expo/react-native deprecation issues newly introduced by Slice C.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:619 — upload_document_blob_sync is a SYNCHRONOUS call (no await) inside an async route. Each blob upload blocks the event loop for the duration of the Supabase Storage round-trip (~200-600ms typically). For the small PDFs used today this is fine, but a 5-10 MB caregiver upload will stall every other request on that worker. Consider asyncio.to_thread(supa_data.upload_document_blob_sync, ...) or making the helper async via httpx.

server.py:679 — get_document_signed_url returns 404 only when signed_url_for_document returns None. For a metadata-only doc (no blob), the synthesized path documents/<id>.pdf does NOT exist in Storage but Supabase happily mints a signed URL for it; the URL then 400s on fetch. Today our test fixture handles either branch, but the public contract in the request says 'returns 404 with detail mentioning stored file' — recommend probing Storage existence (sb.storage.from_(bucket).list with search filter) before minting, OR consult Postgres storage_path IS NOT NULL.

server.py:703-730 — push_document does `clone = {**src}`; if the source dict contains a stale '_id' from Mongo (it shouldn't because of {_id:0} projection, but defensively) the clone.pop('_id', None) handles it, but the clone retains src['file_base64']. For large files this allocates duplicate base64 strings in memory per target. Consider passing file_base64 by reference / streaming once.

core/supa_data.py:343 — upload_document_blob_sync swallows ALL exceptions and returns None. If the upload fails silently, the Postgres row will still be upserted with storage_path=documents/<id>.pdf (computed before the upload result) — leading to a Postgres row that claims a blob exists when Storage has nothing. The signed URL endpoint will mint a URL that 400s. Recommend computing storage_path AFTER successful upload, OR setting storage_path=None on upload failure so the Postgres row reflects reality.
core/supa_data.py:373 — lookup_storage_path_sync is defined but unused in server.py (the route inlines _doc_storage_path directly). Either wire it in for consistency or drop it.
Reload watcher still includes /app/backend/tests/ (carryover from prior iterations); backend reloads when test files are edited.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Slice C is GREEN. All 5 mutating document routes now dual-write Mongo + Postgres + Supabase Storage; Mongo remains authoritative for LIST and single-GET. New additive endpoint GET /api/documents/{id}/url returns a 1h signed URL via supabase service role (no auth needed to fetch the URL). Helpers in supa_data.py: upload_document_blob_sync, delete_document_blob_sync, signed_url_for_document, upsert_document, delete_document, get_document_storage_path. Reusable test fixtures in test_iteration12_phase4c_documents_dualwrite.py: legacy_token (HS256 via /api/auth/login Admin@123), supabase_token (ES256 via gotrue /auth/v1/token with AdminPassword123!), pg_fetchrow/pg_fetchval/pg_execute against SUPABASE_DIRECT_URL with statement_cache_size=0, MINI_PDF_B64 hand-crafted ~250-byte valid PDF, _storage_names() helper. Login mode defaults to Supabase on first page load — to test legacy creds the UI test MUST first click data-testid='auth-mode-toggle'. Documents tab uses testIDs view-doc-<uuid>, push-doc-<uuid>, delete-doc-<uuid>, doc-<uuid>. Next slice likely converts /api/shifts, /api/onboarding, /api/training writes to dual-write, or flips /api/documents LIST to read from Postgres now that storage_path + metadata parity is proven.
